_readme: Identity decisions the OWNER has made by hand. build_identity.py rebuilds the spine with
DELETE FROM player_identity / team_identity, so anything decided here would be lost on a
rebuild unless it is re-applied — which tools/apply_identity_overrides.py does, and
build_identity.py calls at the end of its run.
player_links: player_id -> the eFootball record (ef_pid) and/or FM uid (fm_uid) it IS.
team_links:   team_id   -> the FM club id (fm_club_id) it IS.
Every entry carries why it was decided, so a later reader can re-judge it.

player_links.why: FM's Barcelona 'Rodri' (uid 67217524, dob 22.06.1993, 'D C, DM') is eFootball's Rodri (record 110815, DMF): same birthday once this export's consistent 3-year date shift is undone. Without the link he kept a synthesized 90 while Konami rates him 83.
